value.rationale: This is the complete k-word target distribution for an infinite, noncommutative field-bimodule family, including unequal fields and arbitrary actions. It upgrades 2-factor and aggregate nilpotence questions to every target and every word length, proves that an entire sequence cannot recover centers, and identifies a sharp rare-event survival law. Natural invariant, structural classification, and motivated limitation—not a minor isolated numeric computation.
